title: Secure exposed PostGIS objects through a staged provider-compatible plan

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 audit and approved improvement scope

detail: Read-only metadata identified public.spatial_ref_sys owned by supabase_admin, RLS disabled and broad browser-role privileges. Supabase November4 guidance treats exposed PostGIS objects as a real advisor issue; extension relocation/permission repair needs provider-compatible staging, impact inventory and rollback. This is separate from backup-table containment; do not change extension ownership or apply SQL speculatively. 2026-11-09: re-checked read-only on Frequency Community. Grants still present (anon and authenticated hold INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE; RLS off; owner supabase_admin) and triggers sec007_rows and sec007_truncate are enabled, so writes are refused. The postgres role cannot revoke grants issued by supabase_admin, so the one step left is a Supabase support request run as supabase_admin. Plan, request text and check query: docs/RUNBOOKS.md (PostGIS reference table). The SQL stays at scripts/ops/secure-postgis-reference-table.sql and is never a registered migration. Row stays open until the check query returns false, false, true.

verify.evidence: Metadata-only finding; no exploit, table-row read or mutation performed. Acceptance: exact current extension/object/role inventory; isolated provider/version staging and spatial/webhook/pool compatibility; reviewed committed SQL and Daniel-only execution if required; live effective-permission and application postconditions.
